messages:
carmen: quick follow from the all-hands Q&A 1: two folks asked about off-cycle promotions + retro pay. is there a canonical answer i can copy into a team channel?

 dylan (People Ops): short version: promotions are effective on the date approved. retro pay is considered only if the promo packet shows missed calibration or admin delay. managers should file a retro request via the HR portal within 30 days of approval. i'll paste the form below.

 mira: can we get the link to the retro request form? some managers asked if signoff from 2 leads is required for retro.

 dylan (People Ops): link: <https://hr.redwood.company/forms/promo-retro>. signoff: yes, manager + functional lead approval required for retro pay; exceptions handled by total rewards.

 thomas: another edge case: IC on paid parental LOA got promoted while out. do they keep the promo effective date and retro check still applies?

 dylan (People Ops): good one. promos while on approved LOA are processed the same way. effective date stands. if payroll missed the increase while they were out, submit the retro form; payroll will process catch-up pay. managers should note LOA dates in the packet.

 leah: question about leveling language 1: when we publicly talk to candidates should we use the new descriptive bands or the numeric grades? some recruiting docs still say "grade 4" which confuses candidates.

 dylan (People Ops): recruiting/public-facing docs should use the new band labels; internal comms and calibration still use numeric grades until the switch. recruiting has an update rolling out today. i'll confirm and share the mapping table: numeric -> new-band.

 carmen: thanks 1: and comp timing: if a merit increase is approved in calibration, when does it hit paychecks? managers keep asking if it's immediate.

 dylan (People Ops): merits apply on the next processing cycle. typical lag is 1 pay period; in rare cases (month-end cutoffs) it can be 2. we'll publish a short calendar in the handbook.

 peopleops-bot: People Ops office hours reminder: Friday 10:00 AM PT. Add: <https://calendar.redwood.company/peopleops-officehours>. Reply with :raised_hand: to add a question to the queue.

 mira: is there a place to track promo packet status? managers want visibility after submission.

 dylan (People Ops): yes 1: use the tracker: `hr_tools status --packet=<packet-id>` or view the shared sheet: <https://docs.redwood.company/promo-tracker>. we'll add a manager-facing status column this week.

 thomas: thanks 1: will mention the retro form + tracker in the next manager sync.

 carmen: perfect. copying this to my channel now. :thumbsup:
